name: Tacos Rio Grande
tagline: A San Antonio taco truck on West Hildebrand since 2000.
about: Tacos Rio Grande is a family-friendly taco truck at 1121 W Hildebrand Ave in San Antonio, open since 2000.
Yelp reviewers say the food is consistently good, with great quality, reasonable prices and quick, friendly service.
address: 1121 W Hildebrand Ave, San Antonio, TX 78201
sources: Rating and review: Yelp via MapQuest
